title: Leo's Big New Year Goal: Small Steps Make Big Dreams!

lines.text: Happy New Year, little explorers! Time for a brand new adventure!
lines.caps: *HAPPY New Year, | little *EXPLORERS! | Time for a brand *NEW | *ADVENTURE!

lines.text: Leo made a giant list of one hundred huge New Year goals!
lines.caps: Leo made a giant *LIST | of one hundred huge *NEW | Year *GOALS!

lines.text: Learn to juggle, read fifty books, and build a giant treehouse!
lines.caps: Learn to *JUGGLE, | read fifty books, and *BUILD | a giant *TREEHOUSE!

lines.text: Looking at the giant list made Leo feel nervous and completely stuck!
lines.caps: Looking at the giant *LIST | made Leo feel *NERVOUS | and completely *STUCK!

lines.text: Then his wise teacher said, You don't have to climb the whole mountain today!
lines.caps: Then his wise teacher *SAID, | You don't have to climb the *WHOLE | mountain *TODAY!

lines.text: Just take one tiny, joyful step every single morning!
lines.caps: Just take one *TINY, | joyful step every *SINGLE | *MORNING!

lines.text: Read one page, practice one throw, and hammer one wooden board!
lines.caps: Read one *PAGE, | practice one throw, and *HAMMER | one wooden *BOARD!

lines.text: Tiny daily steps add up to giant superhero dreams!
lines.caps: Tiny daily *STEPS | add up to *GIANT | superhero *DREAMS!

lines.text: Start your journey today and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
